$comment: Contract for data/tables/conversions.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; compiled and applied by build/src/evidence-ledger.js (D153).
title: Conversions
description: The evidence ledger's rows (D153): one per relation that lets a value not measured the way a headline asks bound that headline for the same product, in its one safe direction. A value at another load, in another state, on another bar or of a related property becomes a floor, a ceiling or a band on the headline; the build intersects every applicable row's contribution per product and state, and the engine compares that interval with a requirement only where the product has no comparable value of its own. Each row's band is re-measured at every build on same-sheet pairs (products that publish both values on one sheet) and written to build/snapshot/ledger.csv (CONVERSION-PAIRS). A row lands reported, and is switched to deciding in a commit of its own, with its decision diff.

fields.name: ConversionID
fields.description: CV01, CV02, …; never reused.

fields.name: Target headline
fields.description: The selectable measurement headline the row bounds (headline_definitions.csv): never a headline drawn in the drawer alone, which decides nothing.

fields.name: Source properties
fields.description: The properties whose values bound the target, in the target's unit. The target's own value properties where the row changes only the load, the state, the bar or the direction (an annealed HDT, an upright modulus); another property where the row relates two tests (a flexural modulus, an elongation at yield).

fields.name: Source load MPa
fields.description: The test load a source value must state (an HDT at 1.8 MPa). Not applicable: the target's own load rule.

fields.name: Source direction
fields.description: same: the target's direction rule (an XY headline takes an XY value, and one with no direction stated as published); Z: a value its source says was pulled across the layers; Not applicable on an estimate row (D157).

fields.name: Source state
fields.description: same: a value of the state judged (D99); annealed: a value measured after annealing, bounding the state with no treatment; conditioned: a value measured after moisture conditioning, bounding a dry state; Not applicable on an estimate row (D157).

fields.name: Source specimen
fields.description: as target: a printed bar or one whose sheet does not describe it, as a product value is (D84); printed: a bar its sheet says was printed, for a headline whose lower bound takes printed bars only (elongation, D161); moulded or not stated: a moulded bar or one whose sheet does not describe it; Not applicable on an estimate row (D157).

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: floor: the target is at least source x Factor low + offset; ceiling: at most source x Factor high + offset; band: both; equal: the source stands for the target (Factor low and Factor high the same); demote-to-ceiling: the product's own value from such a bar, as printed, stays its value but may only fail a minimum or pass a maximum, and such values bound the as-printed part from above (an annealed part has crystallised, and is not bounded so); estimate: a conversion only the estimate model reads, its offset in the Estimate columns, which the ledger never reads (D157).

fields.name: Factor low
fields.description: The factor of a floor, a band's low end, or an equality. Not applicable for a ceiling.

fields.name: Factor high
fields.description: The factor of a ceiling, a band's high end, an equality or a demoted value. Not applicable for a floor.

fields.name: Absolute offset
fields.description: Added after the factor, in the target's unit; 0 for none.

fields.name: Applies to
fields.description: Which materials the row holds for, in the registry's Applies-to grammar ("Family: Nylon / Polyamide"; "Base polymer: PLA | PET"; clauses separated by ";" must all hold). Blank: every material the target headline applies to.

fields.name: Physical relation
fields.description: The ordering of physical_relations.csv the row is the projection of, where it is one (PR08: HDT at 1.8 MPa under HDT at 0.45 MPa). Its lower property must be one of the row's source properties and its higher one a value property of the target.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: reported: computed, listed in the snapshot and the drawer as not yet deciding, and never a pass, a fail or a changed reason; deciding: decides where a product has no comparable value. A row is switched in a commit of its own, with its decision diff Not applicable on an estimate row, which never decides (D157).

fields.name: Estimate kind
fields.description: The conversion kind the estimate model reads (build/src/estimate/observations.js kindOf: tensile unk, HDT 1.8 semi-filled, hardness A), or wet / wet-low for the offset of a value measured after moisture conditioning, by its polymer's water uptake. One row per headline and kind; a ledger row carries it where it is the same relation (D157).

fields.name: Estimate offset
fields.description: The documented offset: the headline minus the related value on the model's scale (natural log for density, stiffness, strength and elongation; °C for heat deflection). The build refines it from the grades that publish both, the documented value counting as three pairs, and checks the learned offset against the row's band (CONVERSION-DRIFT, D157).

fields.name: Estimate sd
fields.description: How far one conversion may miss, on the same scale; refined from the pairs' spread.

fields.name: Estimate learns
fields.description: pairs: refined from the grades that publish both kinds; pairs, down only: an unknown direction, never refined above its documented offset (D56); pairs, across products, down only: those pairs pooled with a contrast across products (D159). Not applicable for a wet offset, which is added to its dry conversion's.

fields.name: Estimate note
fields.description: What the conversion is, shown beside an estimate's evidence (estimate.evidence[].conversion).

fields.name: Reason words
fields.description: The source value as a reason names it, after "Meets it on" or at the head of a sentence: "its HDT at 1.8 MPa, a harsher load".

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: A registered source the relation rests on, where one prints it; Not applicable where the band is measured on this database's own same-sheet pairs at every build.

fields.name: Basis
fields.description: Why the relation holds and in which direction it is safe, and where its factor comes from.
